task.title: Run the full Echolet CLI prototype quality gate
task.description: Independently verify the completed CLI, Signal session, relay v2 and real two-process E2E implementation across TypeScript, Go, Metaproject health, graph and wiki checks.
task.scope: full prototype workspace and Metaproject quality evidence

acceptance_criteria: Frozen dependency installation and the production CLI build succeed.
All workspace tests, CLI process tests and three real two-process E2E iterations pass.
Go untagged tests and the full relayv2 race suite pass.
Metaproject strict test and Code Health gates pass or every tool limitation is explicitly evidenced.
The graph rebuild has no cycles, wiki links are valid, and the final result classifies every check without suppressing failures.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action, then load the local code-verifier skill and testing context.
Use keryx ctx for commands/logs and keryx ctx rg for searches; never use bare rg or grep.
Run all checks even after a failure and report exact command labels, statuses and bounded evidence.
Do not change implementation, tests, flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md; only write the verification report and required result artifact.
Do not expose plaintext, profile keys, private key material, ciphertext or request bodies in reports.
Write and validate the required subagent-result; final first line STATUS:.
